formal_title: Primitive-Interaction Hypergraph Reconstruction, Pairwise↔Higher-Order Policy Synergy, Context×Geometry Cross-Term Identifiability, Sparse Interaction Decomposition, Prospective Combination Knockout, Cross-Domain Composition Transport & Reproducible Interaction-Law Reconstruction

suffix_doctrine.reason: Primary function is reconstruction and stress of interaction structure, not a standalone rival-adjudication stage.

primary_question: Does the four-primitive basis support a sparse, cross-domain, action-relevant interaction law whose genuine higher-order terms survive prospective combination knockouts and cannot be reduced to lower-order context effects or geometry/evidence confounds?

interaction_grammar.unit: A matched family with fixed material G and E and prospectively defined primitive combinations.
interaction_grammar.main_effect: Action changes when one primitive changes with all other primitives, G, and E fixed.
interaction_grammar.pairwise_interaction: The joint action effect of two primitives cannot be reconstructed from their separately identified single-coordinate effects under the same matched family.
interaction_grammar.three_way_hyperedge: A three-coordinate joint effect survives every one-coordinate knockout and every pairwise reconstruction under the same matched family.
interaction_grammar.four_way_residue: A four-coordinate joint effect survives all single, pairwise, and triple reconstructions under the same matched family.
interaction_grammar.nonidentifiable: If factorial support is incomplete or G/E/context changes with the combination, classify the edge as bounded/support-only rather than infer a synergy term.

sparse_decomposition.method: Boolean Möbius / inclusion-exclusion style decomposition over prospectively matched primitive subsets, interpreted only for action classes within one operational family.
sparse_decomposition.zero_assumption: Absent support does not imply zero interaction.
sparse_decomposition.sparsity_claim: May be claimed only if supported subsets are complete enough to eliminate all lower-order reconstructions and at least one cross-domain transport witness exists.

prospective_combination_knockout.rule: Interaction authority is earned only by outcome-blindly frozen combination families; no new subset may be added after observing the target action.

context_geometry_cross_terms.target: Test whether primitive interactions change only because G or E changed.
context_geometry_cross_terms.required_control: At least one same-X / varied-G or same-X / varied-E control whenever a context×geometry interaction is claimed.
context_geometry_cross_terms.guard: Do not call a context interaction primitive if geometry or evidence alone explains the action change.

language_plan.rust: Primary interaction verifier and Möbius decomposition.
language_plan.cpp: Sparse subset enumeration and knockout completeness checker.
language_plan.ruby: Harvest lineage, source-to-fragment provenance, and cross-lab backflow manifest.
language_plan.javascript: Final reconstruction aggregator and hosted result emitter.
language_plan.legacy_python: Existing P8-P16 code remains untouched; no language rewrite for aesthetics.

law_r2_gate: LAW-R2 remains unauthorized unless a fresh normalized same-(X,G,E) conflicting action survives all interaction reconstruction and representation controls.
